notes.title: Frenzy VR Sequel, Frenzy Extinction is Now Live –
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427840/194029694f2a2c40d15f3a0aff8ad44784f3e922.png[/img]

Hey everyone,

We’re excited to announce that Frenzy Extinction, the sequel to Frenzy VR, is officially live on Steam! Frenzy Extinction isn’t just a follow-up—it’s an expanded, enhanced version of the survival mechanics you loved in the original game, and it takes the gameplay to the next level.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2884290/Frenzy_Extinction/


[h3] Here’s why Frenzy Extinction is a must-play for fans of Frenzy VR [/h3]
[list]
[*]Bigger and Better Horde Survival: The survival gameplay that defined Frenzy VR returns in Frenzy Extinction, but with more enemies, tougher waves, and larger co-op options. Now, you can team up with up to 3 friends to take on relentless waves of mutated enemies.
[*]Enhanced Combat and Weapons: We’ve taken the physics-based combat from Frenzy VR and pushed it even further. Expect new weapons, more creative gear, and full-body dismemberment physics for a more brutal and immersive experience.
[*]Epic Boss Fights: The bosses in Frenzy Extinction are bigger, more complex, and harder to defeat than anything you’ve faced before in Frenzy VR.
[*]Expanded Maps: Explore 10 brand-new environments, each with unique challenges and hazards. The variety of maps adds new layers of strategy to every session.
[*]Progression and Upgrades: In Frenzy Extinction, you can customize your loadout with more upgrades, perks, and gear options than ever before.
[/list]
Frenzy Extinction takes everything you loved about Frenzy VR and cranks it up a notch. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, the depth and replayability in Frenzy Extinction make it a natural next step in the series.

FrenzyExtinction.com


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42427840/210b3be7a8003eb19aec10c8fe746d275b3ca10b.png[/img]

Steve Ryland, CEO of Innoverse Games, said it best: “Frenzy Extinction expands on the universe we built in Frenzy VR and offers players more of everything—more enemies, more weapons, and more ways to survive. We’re excited to bring this next chapter to the fans who have been with us since the original.”

[h3]We invite everyone who enjoyed Frenzy VR to jump into Frenzy Extinction and see how the franchise has evolved.[/h3]


https://youtu.be/kWyfxOVSdog?si=8QzTtXhle1D4NOdt



— [b]The Innoverse Games Team[/b]

notes.title: Chapter 3 of Story Mode is out now!
notes.notes:
The final part of the Frenzy VR story takes things to a whole new level in this action packed finale. More chaos, explosions and destruction than ever before in the epic conclusion to the story. Find out who made the Frenzy virus, why they did it, and most importantly what it has to do with you.

Other notable changes include:

-Kicking! Launch enemies back with one press of the right joystick and watch as they fly through the air and crumble through the destructible environment.

-Backpack! Take weapons between levels with a handy place to store you favourite killing tools. (Note: the backpack is disabled on some levels in story mode, such as prison and any map in a new dimension. It is also disabled in the challenge mode along with cheats)

-Gravity Gun! Pick up any object and launch it across the room with this new weapon.

-Other new weapons include an Energy Rifle, a new Demon Blade, a Neon sword, and several existing weapons have been added to the weapon spawner

-Challenge mode! A new section in the main menu where you will face several survival challenges with objectives you need to complete. Cheats are disabled in this mode along with the backpack, so it is a true test of skill!

-Free play upgrades! Every map has now 2 challenges, an endless wave spawner and a destruction mode. Highscores for each of these are tracked and can be viewed in the free play menu.

-2 new free play maps! Factory and Underground.

notes.title: Character Customisation!
notes.notes:
Check out the 'home' map in the extra modes area of free play to change your outfit! Check yourself out in the mirror and gear up for some more chaos and mayhem.

Some other minor changes include bug fixes for the Chapter 2 of story mode that was released last week. 
-Fixed bug on nightclubs that prevented you from entering the VIP room.
-Added a new way onto the tall building in rooftops so you don't have to climb.
-Tweaked the tutorial to make it more intuitive.
-Adjusted the grabbing of large furniture

If you haven't jumped into Chapter 2 yet, give it a go!

notes.title: Story Mode Chapter 2 is out!
notes.notes:
The Path Of Destruction (Story Mode) continues in this new update across 6 different maps.

Fight demons in another dimension and escape from prison, pure chaos awaits you in this next chapter of the story.

-Brand new tutorial to introduce all the main mechanics of Frenzy VR.
-Voice lines added to direct the player and help expand the story.
-New maps, weapons, bosses and more.
-Upgrades to gun handling including recoil and new camos. Check out the shooting range in the extra modes.
-Blood decals fixed.
-Many other bug fixes.

As always, feel free to jump into the Discord to let me know your feedback!
Discord.gg/Innoverse

notes.title: Better Combat! Improved Ragdolls & Grip
notes.notes:
Whilst you're waiting for story mode part 2 to come out, here is a little update that drastically changes the combat with enemies. They now react to hits a lot better and have new ragdoll physics!

In case you missed it, I am releasing a free zombie survival game this week called Frenzy: The Ridden. Make sure to join the discord to find out more information!

Other changes this update include:
-Hitting enemies with metal object sounds a lot better
-Weapon spawners placed in the story mode levels
-Improved grip detection on enemies

notes.title: The sandbox update!
notes.notes:
Lots of great changes here to make the free play mode more enjoyable and replayable! 10+ new melee weapons which can all now be spawned on any map (aswell as spawning new enemies!)

-New player model
-New testing area map
-New enemy (in the test map)
-Arena map improved
-Enemy spawner added to every free play level
-Weapon spawner added to every free play level
-10+ new melee weapons
-New setting: Enemies ignore you

notes.title: Welcome to Frenzy VR!
notes.notes:
[h2]Thank you for taking the time to check out my game, Frenzy VR![/h2]

FrenzyVR uses OpenXR, the latest standard for VR games. Below is a quick guide to making sure the game runs on your headset with the correct controls.
[url=https://service.viveport.com/hc/en-us/articles/4423262844813-How-to-setup-correct-OpenXR-runtime]Screenshots on how to enable OpenXR[/url]

-Valve Index / Vive: Launch the game with SteamVR running and everything will work as normal. If the controls don't work, make sure you have the correct OpenXR settings (check the screenshots above)

-Oculus Quest / Rift: Launch the game through Oculus Link or AirLink, and make sure 'Set Oculus as active' has been clicked for the 'OpenXR Runtime' setting. You can find this in the PC Oculus app under settings > general. With this turned on, you can press play and the game will work as normal.


[h3]Other quick tips / information[/h3]

-Make sure to take a look at the settings if you need to adjust things to your own personal preferences. There is a no turn option for people who have stick drift. 

-The basement map in story mode acts as a tutorial, so check it out if you want to master your abilities.

-Part 1 of story mode is out, and more of the story will be released throughout this year.

-Some big changes to the extra modes are coming soon, with survival and arena first on the list to be updated!

[h3]Cheats[/h3]
There is a handy set of cheats, which work in both story mode and free play, so go ahead and cause mayhem to your own liking!

-Easy ragdoll mode: If you just want to throw enemies around then this is the option for you. Any time you grab an enemy they will flop into a ragdoll!

-Infinite health: Finding story mode too hard, or just want to mess around without worrying about dying? This is the setting you are looking for.

-Infinite ammo: You don't even need to load a magazine, just fire away!

-Super punch: Currently experimental, but you do massive damage to enemies with your fists.

[h2]I hope you enjoy the game, and please leave a review![/h2]
